scenarios.title: Module Atlas Structural Sentinel
scenarios.purpose: Checks eight-area topology, direct symbolic reference integrity, and ordering/freshness evidence without rebuilding the module.
scenarios.proof_note: This detects static structural problems before launch. It does not execute M&B conditions, dynamic IDs, or runtime menus.

scenarios.title: Visible Text Flow Sentinel
scenarios.purpose: Preflights visible text sinks, string-register writers, source markers, and static uncertainty before changing strings or UI text.
scenarios.proof_note: Static writer flow is evidence, not a replacement for an in-game route check after a build.

scenarios.title: Semantic Authoring Fixture Sentinel
scenarios.purpose: Runs isolated semantic authoring fixtures for the Atlas, Dialogue Composer, and Presentation Layout Composer without changing live module data.
scenarios.proof_note: These fixtures prove DevKit behavior, not game-engine runtime behavior.
